items.title: Every recursively enumerable language-sound extension of identity-free fixed-point semiring theory is Sigma01-complete
items.author: Anupam Das; Abhishek De; Stepan L. Kuznetsov
items.source_version: Fixed arXiv2512.19401v1 native full article, exact version landing retrieved2026-10-14 explicitly CC BY4.0; strongest thm:undecidability-without-idem with all actual author proof development; same work as FSCD2026.15
items.difficulty_reason: The author builds an effective-inseparability reduction via productive context-free grammars encoding Turing-machine protocols, turns regular totality into small fixed-point-semiring proofs, and removes idempotency/identity assumptions by a productive-expression translation. The final language-sound r.e. extension becomes an r.e. separator and inherits Sigma01-completeness. The complete new grammar and algebraic simulation/translation arguments are retained, supporting H2 as one substantial uniform undecidability construction.
